A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EpiAgent research and contain ten readable pages, including all equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original CIRI restoration experiments, an expert user study, and component ablations in Tables 1–5 and Figures 5–8.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original restoration experiments, expert user study, and ablation results, with one revised ablation configuration label.

M1.justification: The four-stage planner, analysis modules, restoration toolkit, and reevaluation procedure in Section 3 are unchanged. Table 5 revises an experimental configuration without documenting an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CIRI synthetic and real inscription coverage, including test sets S, R-I, and R-II. No dataset, task, or degradation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain CharFormer, DocDiff, GSDM, Restormer, MambaIR, PromptIR, MoCE-IR, and IR3. The planning comparators in Table 4 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 5 changes the final reported configuration from human feedback alone to human feedback with both text authenticity and style consistency enabled. This revises the stated ablation controls; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun. Other experimental settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The final Table 5 condition now assesses combined automatic and human evaluation rather than human evaluation alone. Its comparison with the preceding row therefore concerns adding expert feedback while retaining both automatic criteria. Other ablations and analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The final Table 5 result entry is reassigned to a different declared feedback configuration. Its eight scores, including PSNR 22.14 and 1-NED 0.9069, remain identical. This changes result attribution, without demonstrating a same-setting performance gain; all other results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, action-sequence formulation, execution equation, and failure-set rule in Section 3 and Equations 1–3 are identical. No theoretical result or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about agent-centered restoration, adaptive tool planning, textual authenticity, visual fidelity, and generalization.

C2.justification: The explanations of planning, tool effectiveness, expert feedback, and reflective experience are unchanged, including Section 4.3.4. No applicability boundary or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures, training information, and the code-access link are unchanged. The Table 5 configuration revision supplies no additional implementation or reproducibility instructions.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 48 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 10 April 2026 to v2 dated 27 May 2026. Manuscript prose, terminology, headings, and section order are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, captions, table structure, highlighting, and page layout are unchanged. The two altered Table 5 condition symbols revise experimental content within the existing display.

improvement.justification: Table 5 now identifies its best-scoring row as using all three evaluation signals, aligning it with the combined evaluator in Section 3.4 and the matching full-system scores in Table 1. This modestly improves the clarity and internal consistency of the ablation evidence. Numerical results and the broader scientific content remain unchanged, and no rerun is documented.
